title: AFTER HOURS WASH — A neighbourhood laundry for the evening shift, 6 deliverables

# AFTER HOURS WASH — fixed client service records

## Name and identity
- Name: AFTER HOURS WASH
- Descriptor: Self-service laundry
- Optional line: A lighter load after dark.
- Business: single-shop self-service laundry
- Audience: urban renters washing after work; first-time self-service equipment users
- Name treatment: consistent resolved wordmark; variable capitalisation and line breaks
- Descriptor locations: fascia, entrance window, price card
- Optional descriptor locations: identity sheet, interior boards
- Logo, symbol, colour and font: open design choices
- Symbol: optional
- Identity system: wordmark, colour roles, typography; deliberate single-colour use
- Service identification: readable words, numbers, machine IDs and ordered cues alongside colour

## Opening session
| Record | Time |
| --- | --- |
| Open daily | 17:00–02:00 next day |
| Last wash start | 00:30 |
| Last dry start | 01:20 |

- Session: evening opening through the following morning
- Last-start cutoffs: after midnight, before the same session closes at 02:00

## Service groups and prices
| Group | Fixed machine IDs | Service | Cycle | Price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | W1, W2 | Wash up to 8 kg | 40 minutes | CNY 24 per cycle |
| B | W3, W4 | Wash up to 12 kg | 40 minutes | CNY 32 per cycle |
| D | D1, D2, D3, D4 | Dry up to 12 kg | 30 minutes | CNY 16 per cycle |

- Currency: CNY
- Price basis: tax-inclusive, per cycle
- Wash inclusion: automatically supplied detergent
- Drying: separate purchase from washing
- Dry purchase: one 30-minute cycle
- Service words: Wash, Dry
- Start control label: Start
- Payment location: in-store kiosk

## Customer journey
| Step | Action |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Choose an available machine |
| 2 | Load laundry and close its door |
| 3 | Choose that machine's ID at the in-store kiosk |
| 4 | Pay at the kiosk |
| 5 | Press Start at the selected machine |

- Applicable groups: A, B, D
- First-visit decisions: opening period, last-start cutoff, capacity, price, machine ID
- Machine-zone board information: service table, both last-start cutoffs, wash inclusions, separate drying, five operating actions
- Price card information: service table, opening period, both last-start cutoffs, wash inclusions, separate drying

## Waiting area
- Facilities: seating and folding counter
- Counter etiquette: clear space for folding
- During a cycle: customer nearby
- End of a cycle: laundry removed
- Calls after 22:00: quiet
- Waiting-board content: all four etiquette messages
- Optional waiting-board line: A lighter load after dark.

## Artwork surfaces
| Surface | Width | Height | Orientation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fascia | 4000 mm | 600 mm | Horizontal |
| Entrance-window graphic | 900 mm | 1800 mm | Upright |

- Exterior dimensions: usable artwork surfaces
- Interior boards: machine-zone and waiting-zone communications

## Image records
- laundry-surfaces.png: dimensioned fascia and entrance-window artwork rectangles
- front-loading-machine.png: equipment identity; circular door, visible drum, rectangular cabinet
- evening-materials.png: atmosphere reference; folded textiles, warm light, restrained material colours

| 4 | machine-zone-board | Machine-zone board | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | waiting-zone-board | Waiting-zone board | 6 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
AFTER HOURS WASH | A neighbourhood laundry for the evening shift

We are opening a single self-service laundry for urban renters doing their washing after work. Build an identity that helps people spot the shop from the street, choose a machine on their first visit and settle into the waiting area. Print the name "AFTER HOURS WASH" on all six finished pieces, using one resolved wordmark; capitalisation and line breaks may vary. Print the descriptor "Self-service laundry" on the fascia, entrance window and price card. The optional line is "A lighter load after dark." The logo, colours and typography are open for development.

We open daily from 17:00–02:00 next day, with last wash start at 00:30 and last dry start at 01:20, both after midnight in that evening's session. Group A, machines W1 and W2, washes up to 8 kg for 40 minutes at CNY 24 per cycle. Group B, W3 and W4, washes up to 12 kg for 40 minutes at CNY 32 per cycle. Group D, D1, D2, D3 and D4, dries up to 12 kg for 30 minutes at CNY 16 per cycle. Prices include tax; wash cycles include automatic detergent, and drying is purchased separately. The fascia artwork surface is 4000 mm wide by 600 mm high; the entrance-window surface is 900 mm wide by 1800 mm high. The attached machine image anchors the recognisable front-loading equipment form wherever equipment is illustrated.

Audience: the shop owner and signage supplier, choosing the finished identity and preparing the exterior graphics, interior boards and customer price card for opening.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the operating hours, service records, customer journey, waiting etiquette and artwork dimensions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. laundry-surfaces.png gives the two fixed exterior artwork surfaces and their dimensions. front-loading-machine.png supplies the equipment identity through its circular door, visible drum and rectangular cabinet. evening-materials.png provides atmosphere through folded textiles, warm light and restrained material colours.

Deliverables:
1. One finished identity sheet containing the resolved wordmark, its single-colour version, colour codes and roles, and typography samples
2. One fascia application for the 4000 mm × 600 mm surface, carrying the wordmark and descriptor
3. One entrance-window application for the 900 mm × 1800 mm surface, carrying the wordmark, descriptor, daily opening period and both last-start cutoffs
4. One machine-zone board containing the wordmark, all three service groups with machine IDs, capacities, cycle lengths and prices, both last-start cutoffs, detergent and separate-drying information, and the five ordered operating steps
5. One waiting-zone board containing the wordmark and four messages covering the folding counter, staying nearby, collecting finished laundry and quiet calls after 22:00
6. One price and service card containing the wordmark, descriptor, daily opening period, both last-start cutoffs, all three service groups and the detergent and separate-drying information

Acceptance:
- All six pieces use the identity sheet's resolved AFTER HOURS WASH wordmark, colour roles and typography; the sheet supplies colour codes and a single-colour wordmark. Any equipment illustrations retain the attached machine image's circular door, visible drum and rectangular cabinet.
- The fascia and entrance-window applications fit 4000 mm × 600 mm and 900 mm × 1800 mm respectively. The fascia, entrance window and price card print Self-service laundry, with the shop name leading the fascia's reading order.
- The entrance window and price card state daily opening as 17:00–02:00 next day. The entrance window, machine-zone board and price card label last wash start as 00:30 and last dry start as 01:20, making their after-midnight timing clear.
- The machine-zone board and price card each distinguish Wash A: W1, W2, up to 8 kg, 40 minutes, CNY 24 per cycle; Wash B: W3, W4, up to 12 kg, 40 minutes, CNY 32 per cycle; and Dry D: D1, D2, D3, D4, up to 12 kg, 30 minutes, CNY 16 per cycle. Both state that prices include tax, detergent is automatically included with washing, drying is purchased separately, and the dry price covers one 30-minute cycle. Words and IDs identify each group alongside colour.
- The machine-zone board numbers these five actions in order: choose an available machine; load laundry and close its door; choose that machine's ID at the in-store kiosk; pay at the kiosk; press Start at the selected machine. Start and the machine IDs remain readable within the operating information.
- The waiting-zone board communicates all four messages: keep the counter clear for folding; stay nearby while a cycle runs; remove laundry when the cycle ends; keep calls quiet after 22:00. If the optional line appears on any piece, its wording is A lighter load after dark.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
